articleTitle: Postpartum Rage: The Symptoms No One Prepares You For
imageHeadline: Postpartum rage is real—and more common than you think
imageSubtext: Hair-trigger anger, physical tension, and why it's a symptom worth naming
pinTitle: Postpartum Rage Symptoms: Why New-Mom Anger Feels Different & What Helps
pinDescription: Sudden, intense anger that feels involuntary? Physical tension, disproportionate reactions, and a nervous system on high alert? Postpartum rage is a documented symptom—often linked to postpartum anxiety—that standard screenings miss. Understand what's happening in your brain and body, and why it's worth talking about.

items.label: The anger hits fast and feels disproportionate to the trigger
Your body registers it: racing heart, clenched jaw, tight shoulders
It's a common symptom of postpartum anxiety, not a character flaw
